svg.title: hapax: the stages of a run, the three output classes, and the scale they share
svg.desc: Panel a lists the seven stages of a run, with what each is given and what it writes: resolve, library accession → its trim, block size and panels, writes every value with how it was established, or a refusal to run; merge, read pairs → one read per overlapping molecule, writes a merged read where a pair overlaps, per-mate rows where it does not; assemble, the whole library → contigs, writes contigs with mapped depth and evenness, and recovery against a truth panel; identify, reads and contigs against indexes, cheapest first → tiers, writes the tier table and the evidence behind every removal, per route; score the distance, every contig, removed or kept → one row on one scale, writes identity and coverage per gene, nucleotide and protein, with the index used; report the residue, reads nothing named → one row per pair, writes no threshold applied, each field beside its shuffled and known-positive controls; subtract other plants, a panel of libraries from elsewhere → witnessed or not, writes the witnessed fraction at both operating points, paired by plant. Panel b lists the three output classes, what each reports and what it refuses to claim: A, divergent but related contigs, reports distance from published sequence with the closest relative named, per gene, no species call; whole-contig identity is whichever gene won; B, novel strains of known viruses, reports the near end of the same scale, treated as a first-class case, no separation below the assembler's fusion limit; reported as fused; C, the unplaceable residue, reports distance without identity, with the depth it was observed at, no “matches nothing”, and no claim that more sequencing would place it. Panel c is the distance scale all three sit on, running from far from published sequence to matched. The figure carries no result from any sample.
svg.text: Known sequence is identified and removed. The remainder is measured against published sequence.

svg.text: Removal applies to read pairs. Contigs are measured whether or not an index names them. A stage missing an input is recorded as skipped and the run marked incomplete.
No parameter is inferred from another sample, and no stage falls back to a cheaper index. How much each tier removes is a property of the library and is measured per run.
bThree output classes, on one scale
what each reports, and what it will not claim

g.text: Adivergent but related contigs
distance from published sequence with the closest relative named, per gene
no species call; whole-contig identity is whichever gene won
Bnovel strains of known viruses
the near end of the same scale, treated as a first-class case
no separation below the assembler's fusion limit; reported as fused
Cthe unplaceable residue
distance without identity, with the depth it was observed at
no “matches nothing”, and no claim that more sequencing would place it
far from published sequence
matched
One mark per contig, no thresholds. A row gives the distance to its closest
published relative and the identity of that relative. Where one is absent,
the report states which. Search establishes prior knowledge. It does not
establish novelty, because score ordering tracks proximity to the database.

svg.text: This figure describes the report, not a result: it carries no number from any sample. The measurements behind each rule are in results/, on the libraries named there.
